verdicts.why: Amal said only 'Nice.' and her chat typed sitte u 3eshreen, which reads as a transcription of what she heard, so 2023 is most likely the engine guessing a year; even if he said it, a wrong year is a fact slip with no voiced signal, not a vocab error under the brief.
He asked for the dish's name at 18:21 and Amal supplied مسخن at 18:43, which he repeated with effort (مسخ- مسخة. مسخن at 19:15); the brief files that as vocab-A, signal asked, tier 0 (a didn't-know).

Amal voiced it twice, 'No, you said طريق التاني' (36:30) and الطريق التاني (36:26), quoting his form; the brief says to trust her echo when his line is missing, and he then said الطريق الثاني at 37:14.

At 38:56 he repeats the بخوّف that Amal had just accepted with 'There you go' at 38:20; in Levantine the he-form bi-khawwef is normally pronounced like بخوف, Amal gave no signal, and the chat line alone is not a correction.

He said 'bi-' at 59:08 before عطلتك, so the بـ was there and only split up by his pause; Amal said 'Nice.', and her chat line enbasa6ti bi3utletek matches what he was building, so there was no voiced fix.
